title: Monthly Garden Work Day - January
blurb: Join us for our monthly garden work day! We'll be doing general maintenance, planting, and community building.
content:
**Come help us maintain and improve our community garden. Activities include:**

- Weeding and mulching
- Planting new crops
- General garden maintenance
- Community building

All skill levels welcome! Tools and materials provided.

garden.blurb: A vibrant community garden in the heart of downtown
garden.title: Downtown Community Garden
garden.welcome_text: Welcome to our downtown garden community!
garden.welcome_email_body:
Hi {{firstName}},

Thanks so much for signing up to volunteer with {{gardenName}} — we're really excited to have you with us!

We look forward to seeing you at our next volunteer day. It's a great chance to get your hands dirty, meet some fellow gardeners, and make a real difference in the community.

Got an idea? Pitch it. Garden Steward is more than volunteer days. If there's a project you'd love to make happen, whether it's at Gravity Garden or right on your own block, you can pitch it to us on steward.garden. We're a growing community of people who like to get involved, and we'd love to help get your idea off the ground.

In the meantime, if you have any questions, ideas, or just want to say hi — please don't hesitate to reach out. We're always happy to hear from you.

See you in the garden!

Warm regards,
{{senderName}}
